# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the time of his death  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Green Gables, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c37 P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking, ungainly man with stooping shoulders and long iron-gray hair touching them. He wore a full, soft brown beard that he had maintained since he was twenty years old. Lacking only a little grayness earlier in life, he appeared at twenty very much as he did at sixty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew was extremely shy and quiet, feeling painfully uncomfortable around women and secretly fearing they laughed at him. Despite his bashfulness, he possessed a soft, kind heart and deep affection for those he loved. He was quietly indulgent and supportive, willing to undergo uncomfortable ordeals to bring joy to others.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Traits

- Extremely shy around women  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012)</sub>
- Kind-hearted and indulgent  <sub>[v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v1 c37 P17](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0017)</sub>
- Afraid of strange females  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c37 P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002)</sub>

## Goals

- To adopt an orphan boy to assist with farm work  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>
- To ensure Anne feels loved and receives pretty clothes  <sub>[v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at the Green Gables estate in Avonlea alongside his sister, Marilla. Intending to adopt a boy to help with farm chores, he drove to Bright River station, only to encounter eleven-year-old Anne Shirley instead. Unwilling to leave the child stranded, he took her home and quickly formed a deep, affectionate bond with her. Desiring to give Anne a stylish dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas, he endured a agonizing shopping trip at a local store before seeking help from Mrs. Rachel Lynde to carry out the task. Years later, after returning from the post office, Matthew collapsed and passed away instantaneously at the doorway of Green Gables due to the sudden shock of reading about the Abbey Bank failure. He was buried surrounded by his mother's old-fashioned garden flowers.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016)</sub>
- Maintained the same bearded appearance from age twenty to sixty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Had a lifelong wordless love for old-fashioned garden flowers planted by his mother  <sub>[v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m not expecting a girl, It’s a boy I’ve come for. He should be here. Mrs. Alexander Spencer was to bring him over from Nova Scotia for me.  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>

> I’m sorry I was late, Come along. The horse is over in the yard. Give me your bag.  <sub>[v1 c2 P18](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0018)</sub>

> Have you any—any—any—well now, say any garden rakes?  <sub>[v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009)</sub>

> Well now—if it isn’t too much trouble—I might as well—that is—I’d like to look at—at—some sugar.  <sub>[v1 c25 P16](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0016)</sub>

> Well now, I’m much obliged, and—and—I dunno—but I’d like—I think they make the sleeves different nowadays to what they used to be. If it wouldn’t be asking too much I—I’d like them made in the new way.  <sub>[v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)</sub>
